title: Composite Material Failure Analyzer — Overview and definition
t: Composite Material Failure Analyzer — Overview and definition
description: Evaluates laminate failure with progressive damage criteria.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Evaluates laminate failure with progressive damage criteria. A composite failure analyzer applies Tsai-Wu, Hashin, Puck, and LaRC criteria ply by ply, degrades stiffness progressively, and predicts first-ply and ultimate failure. Real implementations include Helius, GENOA, and Abaqus composite damage. It sizes laminates to damage-tolerance requirements.
capabilities: Classical laminate theory with failure criteria

description: Evaluates laminate failure with progressive damage criteria.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Teaching ladder for Composite Material Failure Analyzer, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Classical laminate theory with failure criteria). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Classical laminate theory with failure criteria and Progressive damage and stiffness degradation. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Computational fracture mechanics solver) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
